_comment: Big, one step up the size axis: twice what was tuned, where `colossal` is four times. The axis is
geometric, so the five words -- minuscule, small, unsaid, large, colossal -- are equal steps.
No query, where `colossal` restricts the landmass to `monumental`: a large thing is still an
ordinary one, and only the end of the axis should pull the draw towards the landforms built big.
